text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"Clear opening position and reasons","quality":"argument focus","description":"The essay states a defensible claim early and previews the main reasons it will argue for."},{"evidence":"Second paragraph explains crashes with article details","quality":"use of evidence","description":"The essay supports its claims with relevant information from the source article rather than relying mainly on opinion."},{"evidence":"“If a person does not have the reflexes…” / “This would help transportation…”","quality":"elaboration","description":"The essay develops its points with explanation of how the evidence supports the claim instead of just mentioning facts."},{"evidence":"Three-part structure with intro, two body paragraphs, and conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is more clearly arranged into distinct sections that build the argument in a logical sequence."},{"evidence":"“In conclusion… Just think…”","quality":"concluding effectiveness","description":"The ending wraps up the position and leaves the reader with a final forward-looking thought."}]}
